# `vox-kb-facets`

**Crate:** `vox-kb-facets` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

L0 KB facet contract: facet types, eligibility rule, summary block, provenance validators, taxonomy and backlog (KB Phase 4).

## Crate Overview

L0 KB facet contract (KB Phase 4, D-01).

Pure: no I/O and no hashing. Lint, indexer, MENS builder and the generated schema all read
facets through this crate, so a doc cannot be eligible in one consumer and ineligible in
another.


## Public API Surface

### Structs

| Struct | Description |
|---|---|
| `Source` | One entry of `sources[]`; every field is optional so a gap is a lint error, not a parse error. |
| `Facets` | Typed KB facets read from page frontmatter. Unknown frontmatter keys are ignored. |

### Enums

| Enum | Description |
|---|---|
| `Authorship` | Who wrote the page. |
| `Origin` | How the page entered the KB. |
| `KbTier` | Which collection the page belongs to: Vox docs or the general library. |
| `TrustTier` | Trust level of the page; same wire strings as `ContextTrustTier`. |
| `Scope` | Whether the page is about Vox internals or external subject matter. |
| `Sensitivity` | Egress sensitivity; `private` pages must not leave the machine. |

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `parse_facets` | Parse facets from a whole document. No `---` fence at all or an empty block is `Facets::default()` (grandfathered, D-05). A fence that is opened but not recognised (unterminated, indented, preceded by a blank line) or holds an invalid facet value is an `Err`: callers must treat it as "not eligible", never as "no facets" (CR-01). |
| `is_valid_attestation` | True when `human_attested_by` names a person: non-blank and not a placeholder or AI name (case-insensitive, whole value). |
| `forced_training_ineligible` | True when the page is forced training-ineligible: web-promoted or LLM-authored content with no valid `human_attested_by` ([`is_valid_attestation`]). |
| `effective_training_eligible` | The one shared MENS eligibility rule (D-05, D-06): not forced-ineligible and the flag, which defaults to true. |
| `facet_json_schema` | Draft-07 JSON Schema for [`Facets`] (the GUI type and the 04-03 golden read this). |
